# EvHoverCard

> A hover card is a small overlay that appears when the user hovers over a trigger, surfacing a preview — a title with an optional description and caption — without a click.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:hover-card` |
| Layer | Molecule (`src/molecules`) |
| Import | `import { EvHoverCard } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvHoverCard>` or `<ev-hover-card>` |
| Source | `src/molecules/hover-card/EvHoverCard.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the inner `<div class="ev-hover-card__panel">`, not the root |

## Example

```vue
<EvHoverCard
  model-value
  title="Alex Wijaya"
  description="Product designer, tim Platform"
  subtext="Bergabung Maret 2021"
>
  @alex
</EvHoverCard>
```

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Hover Card**, frame `4278:80082` (Hover Card). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Use a hover card to reveal contextual preview information about a linked entity (user, repository, term) on hover — without forcing the user to navigate away.

### When not to use

- Don't use for critical actions or content the user must see — hover is not available on touch devices. Use a Tooltip (`evoq-ui:tooltip`) for short text-only hints, or a Popover (`evoq-ui:popover`) for click-triggered interactive content.

### Do

- Keep the content concise and scannable — a title, a short description, and at most one or two supporting details. Trigger on a meaningful delay to avoid accidental flicker.

### Don't

- Don't overload the card with long paragraphs, multiple actions, or nested interactive elements. Don't put essential controls inside it, since it dismisses as soon as the pointer leaves.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvHoverCard`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the inner `<div class="ev-hover-card__panel">`, not the root.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:hover-card` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
